name: e2e-open-panel
description: The status bar button and the shortcut run Map pane through both shipped plugins: A starts pairing on the deck and asks B to show the panel, B calls Orca's plugins.open and answers, and the panel is in map mode (deck.get says so) until a key is chosen. When Orca refuses to open the panel, the deck-only flow stays. Revert check: drop the openPanel send in the deck.map command (main.mjs): the toast is the deck-only one and Orca is never asked.

result: Pick a key in the Agent Deck panel, or press one on the deck
Press a key on the deck to map this pane
